text:
alex: Quick question — as we lock down the rollforward policy, where should feature flag origination be recorded? console vs runtime API? we need a single source of truth + audit trail. pinging @maria @noah

maria: my preference is console as the canonical author for human-driven changes, but the infra API (terraform/cli) must be able to originate programmatic changes. metadata needs to include origin + actor + change_id.

noah: agree. also we should record intent (canary vs emergency) so the rollout controller knows whether to auto-rollforward or require approvals.

lin: important note: private deployments run a different control plane. metadata must replicate but PII (user emails) should be masked. we should sign changes with the cluster key for provenance.

sam: from the console side we can add an "origin" dropdown (console, api, terraform, cli, webhook) and surface the change_id + link to audit. small change in UI.

maria: telemetry: emit a compact event 'flag.change' with fields: origin, actor_id (hashed), change_id, before_ref, after_ref, apply_mode. keep payload small and emit pointer to full diff.

noah: also propose an 'apply_mode' enum: dry_run | staged | immediate. automated rollforward only transitions staged -> immediate; immediate should be explicit operator action.

alex: sketch of metadata for a change:
```json
{"flag":"slow_path","change_id":"chg_20260320_01","origin":"console","actor":"maria","apply_mode":"staged","mask_email":true}
```

lin: for private deployments add "origin_signed":true and "signer": "cluster-01". runtime can reject unsigned origin if policy requires it.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: noted: rollout-controller config updated. canary policy: auto-rollforward disabled for origin==terraform unless operator_override==true.

sam: UX question: should console show approver + approval timestamp inline? I think yes — it'll help oncall and audits.

maria: approval workflow would be a one-click approve in console that creates a signed change and emits the audit event. operator_override flagged in metadata.

noah: edge-case: old flags created before change_id exists. we need a migration to assign synthetic change_ids and an import pointer for audit_chain.

alex: ACTIONS: (1) infra/schema: add origin + change_id + apply_mode (owner: noah) (2) runtime: enforce apply_mode transitions and verify origin signature (owner: lin) (3) console: add origin UI + approve button (owner: sam) (4) telemetry: finalize event schema + pointer semantics (owner: maria) (5) migration: backfill change_ids for legacy flags (owner: noah)

sam: I'll mock wireframes and a tiny acceptance flow. ETA EOD Friday.

maria: I'll draft the telemetry event spec and publish to docs repo.

noah: I'll open the schema PR and start adding fields. will tag reviewers.

alex: OK, adding this to SRE sync deck. meeting Tues to review PRs. thanks all. :thumbsup: 

lin: one more thought: store an immutable audit_chain pointer (S3/object_id) instead of raw diffs in events. keep events cheap.

maria: +1 — events carry pointer, docs store full diff + signatures.

alex: wrap-up: aim for small iterative changes so we can ship without breaking private control plane. see you at the sync. :calendar:
